newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA, ZAMBIA TO TIGHTEN BORDER CONTROLS.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA, ZAMBIA TO TIGHTEN BORDER CONTROLS.

text.p: Security along the Namibia-Zambia border is to be tightened and improved, a joint commission on defence and security agreed this week.
"The meeting noted with satisfaction progress made in the cooperation that exists between Namibia and Zambia, especially in the prevention of cross-border crime," a joint statement said on Friday.

The commission did not say why controls were being tightened, although Namibia's government has recently expressed growing concern over increased cross-border smuggling, an influx of illegal immigrants and growing drug trafficking.
